description: Public Transport Accessibility Level (PTAL) - Melbourne metro is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. Public Transport Accessibility Level (PTAL) is a measure used in transport planning to assess how well a specific location is connected to the public transport network. The Car Parking Requirement Maps were developed using the Public Transport Accessibility Level (PTAL) methodology. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are Transportation. It offers 9 resource(s) in DWG, DXF, EXTENDED TAB, GDB, MIF. The portal shows 2026-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
